text: Failure is tuition. You pay for it with disappointment, embarrassment, sometimes money. But the lesson, if you learn it, is yours forever. Most people waste their tuition. They fail, feel bad, and move on without extracting the lesson. That is the real failure — not the mistake, but the refusal to learn from it. The people who succeed are not the ones who avoid failure. They are the ones who pay attention when it happens. They are the ones who ask: What can I learn? What will I do differently?
